reason: I already got my data dumped in a breach and now a startup I have never heard of wants an account so I can hunt settlements? That is how you get hit a second time. I treat those notice emails as spam anyway and I would close this tab the second it asked for anything identifying.
objection: I do not want a random site storing my name, email, or anything that could ID me. Free during beta just makes it feel like they are collecting people, not helping them.
would_change_my_mind: If I could search the named breach and get a link to the official claim form with no account and no personal details collected at all.
